user_story:
As a user, I want to view a product catalogue with the ability to sort products so that I can easily find the products I am interested in. Acceptance criteria: 
1. The page should display all products with their names and 'Add to cart' buttons. 
2. I should be able to sort the products by options available in the dropdown with data-test='product-sort-container'. 
3. After sorting, products should be displayed according to the selected sorting method without navigating away from the inventory page.
